recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構大致被抹除，副皮質區擴大，只剩少數殘存濾泡；高倍下是中等大小、核稍不規則且可見小核仁的淋巴細胞，間雜許多粉紅色細胞質的組織球與凋亡小體，符合全身性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤的淋巴結表現。
features: Low power: largely effaced nodal architecture with expanded paracortex and only a few residual follicles
Intact capsule with congested vessels at the periphery
High power: medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Numerous admixed histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic bodies/eosinophilic apoptotic cells without prominent Reed-Sternberg-like cells
describe_en: Sections of cervical lymph node show largely effaced architecture with marked paracortical expansion and only a few residual follicles beneath an intact capsule. At high power, the paracortex is infiltrated by a population of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with numerous histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered apoptotic bodies. No sheets of large anaplastic cells or classic Reed-Sternberg cells are seen. In correlation with the T-cell immunophenotype and diffuse EBER positivity, findings are consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: IM shows a polymorphous paracortical immunoblastic proliferation with plasma cells and EBER-positive B immunoblasts, preserved sinuses and polyclonal T cells.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and PD-1/CXCL13+ neoplastic cells, with EBER mainly in scattered B cells rather than the T cells.
PTCL-NOS can look identical but lacks EBV infection of the majority of neoplastic T cells on EBER ISH.
THRLBCL contains scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell/histiocyte background, whereas here the atypical cells are T cells.
